name: FlipNeRF
aliases: Flipped Reflection Rays for Few-shot Novel View Synthesis
definition: A regularization method for few-shot novel view synthesis that uses flipped reflection rays as additional training resources to improve surface normal estimation and reduce floating artifacts.
summary: FlipNeRF is a few-shot novel view synthesis method that improves rendering quality by generating auxiliary flipped reflection rays from estimated surface normals for consistency regularization.
